claim: On 2023-06-08 AWS RAM increased the maximum number of pending invitations per sharing account from 20 to 250; 250 is the default quota today, and it is adjustable.

evidence.quote: | [Service quota limit increase for pending invitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ram/latest/userguide/service-quotas.html) | The maximum number of pending invitations per sharing account has been increased from 20 to 250. | June 8, 2023 |
| Number of pending invitations | Each supported Region: 250 |  [Yes](https://console.aws.amazon.com/servicequotas/home/services/ram/quotas/L-238C96EE)  | The maximum number of pending invitations. |
